name: Replay Strategies Benchmark for Continual Learning
description: With the capacity of continual learning, humans can continuously acquire knowledge throughout their lifespan. However, computational systems are not, in general, capable of learning tasks sequentially. This long-standing challenge for deep neural networks (DNNs) is called catastrophic forgetting. Multiple solutions have been proposed to overcome this limitation. This paper makes an in-depth evaluation of the memory replay methods, exploring the efficiency, performance, and scalability of various sampling strategies when selecting replay data. All experiments are conducted on multiple datasets under various domains. Finally, a practical solution for selecting replay methods for various data distributions is provided.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on continual learning replay strategies across multiple datasets; results depend heavily on backbone model, task sequence, and memory budget.
